note: BUILD_SPEC §12.3 fixed task set. Run with LOAM_SWARM_TASKSET=bench/swarm-taskset.json and LOAM_SWARM_COMPARE_ROUNDS=3. S1 is the existing compare brief (probed live); the others use completed + recorded verification as the productWorks proxy.

tasks.brief: Write slugify.js exporting slugify(text): lower-case, trim, Arabic letters kept, runs of non-letters become one dash. Add slugify.test.js with node:test (5 cases). Verify with node --test slugify.test.js.

In the existing calculator.cjs, make divide(a, b) throw an Error containing 'zero divisor' when b is 0, without changing calculator.test.cjs; add a test for it in divide.test.cjs. Verify with node --test.

Build a notes REST API in Node.js with no packages: server.cjs with GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /notes, notes stored in notes.json, tag filtering via ?tag=, full-text search via ?q=, validation with 400 errors (title required, max 200 chars), and notes.test.cjs covering every route. Listen on process.env.PORT only when run directly.

Build an expense tracker web app in Node.js with no packages: server.cjs serving an Arabic RTL page at / (form for amount, category, date; a list; a monthly total per category) and a JSON API (GET/POST /expenses, DELETE /expenses/:id) persisted to expenses.json; validation with 400 errors; expenses.test.cjs covering the API and the totals.

Build a team task board in Node.js with no packages: login with a password hashed by crypto.scrypt and a session cookie; tasks with title, assignee and status stored in tasks.json; an Arabic RTL board page with three columns; REST API for tasks (GET/POST/PATCH); plus tasks.test.cjs covering login and the API.

Build a small library loans system in Node.js with no packages: staff login with a password hashed by crypto.scrypt and a session cookie; books, members and loans stored in a JSON database file with a migration step; an admin dashboard page (Arabic RTL) listing overdue loans; REST API for books, members, loans (borrow, return, renew with a 3-renewal limit); a daily overdue report exported as CSV; and node:test coverage for auth, loans rules and the CSV export.
